[[p0]] (string) Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request. If provided with no value or the value [[p1]], prints a sample input JSON that can be used as an argument for [[p2]]. The formatting style to be used for binary blobs. The default format is base64. The base64 format expects binary blobs to be provided as a base64 encoded string. Strategies used when step fails, we support Continue and Abort. Abort will fail the automation when the step fails.
